info.title: EmilyBase experimental HTTP API
info.description: Synthetic data only. Not production-ready. Limits and error outcomes: docs/server.md. String byte limits and display-name controls are stricter than JSON Schema length. JSON integer clients must preserve signed i64. Do not retry unknown write outcomes.

post.description: Available in legacy registry mode. The fixed account_router transport refuses dynamic project creation with405.

post.summary: Provision private account with service key
post.description: Available only through the explicit account_router library transport; native binary mode selection is pending. Not anonymous signup. Bearer ProjectKey is a private service key, never a public frontend credential. User tokens grant no SQL authority. Strict4096-byte JSON/five-second body bound; no client time.30 private attempts per project/minute plus120 per peer IP/minute. See docs/private-http.md.

sql.description: UTF-8 input <=16384 bytes; documented bounded SQL subset.

login.description: Canonical lowercase ASCII identifier; byte policy is enforced by the account library.

password.description: Exact UTF-8 bytes including NUL; at most1024 bytes, stricter than character length.
